integrity: Analytical proof given, separately derived exact rational identities and independent stochastic occupation diagnostics included; no external or independent scientific certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Population moments for independent Brownian rotational dynamics and complete deterministic Poisson resetting only; not finite-sample statistical inference. Only dimensionless diffusivities and rates are identified without an external resetting clock. Isotropy eliminates orientation information, and the fast-rotation limit is ill-conditioned.
title: Exact angular-moment hierarchy and stationary-position tomography for reset anisotropic Brownian particles
